item.text:
Mistral’s documentation currently lists Predicted Outputs for:

- Mistral Medium 3.5 (`mistral-medium-3-5`)
- Mistral Small 4 (`mistral-small-2603`)
- Codestral (`codestral-2508`)
- Z.ai GLM 5.2 (`zai-glm-5-2`)
- Ministral 3 3B (`ministral-3b-2512`)

The feature is also documented for older/deprecated models, including Mistral Large 2.1, Mistral Medium 3/3.1, Mistral Small 3.1/3.2, and Pixtral Large. For new integrations, use the current models above. [Mistral Predicted Outputs documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/advanced/predicted-outputs), [Mistral model comparison](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/compare?models=ministral-3-3b-25-12)
